title: Business Analyst
description:
The qualified candidate must possess the following skills and years of experience
in the following areas:
 3+ years of work experience in Information Technology or Data Analysis.
 3+ years of work experience gathering business requirements, including:
functional, user, and system requirements; creating application wireframes;
developing process flow diagrams; writing high-quality technical and user
guide documentation; performing heavy research; and other business
analysis tasks for software/SDLC implementation projects.
 1+ year of experience as a project manager over a project with a heavy IT
component. Expected first-hand knowledge/experience with various
assignment, resource allocation, and monitoring tools.
 Intermediate to advanced knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, Project, and
PowerPoint is required.
 Demonstrated experience in extracting and translating large data sets and
relational databases.
Skills required:
 Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
 Strong organizational skills; highly detail-oriented
 Works effectively in a diverse team environment
 Ability to communicate and present in large groups and team meetings
 Ability to confidently interact with members of project including third parties,
developers, sponsors, users, and management
 Possess good customer service skills
 Excellent problem solving and follow-through skills
 Ability to collect, evaluate and interpret complex information and data
 Ability to create complex spreadsheets, dashboards, records and reports
 Efficiently manage multiple tasks and bring deliverables to completion in a
deadline-driven environment

title: Business Analyst
description:
The qualified BA candidate must possess the following:

Experience in data quality assurance and validation

Knowledge of and experience in business analysis practices (requirements, gathering, process documentation)

Experience participating in UAT for enterprise systems

Familiarity with structured datasets and data governance

(Preferred) Experience with SQL databases, permitting systems, or address standards
